decision.rationale: TXN-007913 (541.68 EUR, Brightwater Gadgets, card CRD-000115) posted on 2026-10-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 12 days later, so it is well within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000019 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-13. The dispute was opened 9 days after that date. Policy requires the cardholder to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, so a late delivery can still arrive. A dispute opened before then is declined. The waiting period ends on 2026-10-28, and the cardholder may open a new dispute from that date if the goods still have not arrived. Delivery and refunds were not checked, because the waiting period decides the case first.
